name: DataLens
summary: Profile a CSV, uncover missing values, and apply explicit quality rules. Turn a first look into a reproducible data-quality report.

name: Pipeline Pulse
summary: Inspect structured activity logs, group failure signals, and prepare an incident handoff with rule-based diagnostic suggestions.

name: Privacy Forge
